title: apex-ayl.118 RED ratchet (openai side sweep F9) — body identity (user / safety_identifier) unreachable on the responses wire: the case declares model/gpt-5.6-sol/user=redstack-ow-metadata-01 (config_patch intent; the lenient row parser ignores the key pre-cut) and pins the configured user value + 'safety_identifier' on the /v1/responses request bodies. The fork hardcodes body user/safety_identifier to None (SA/client.rs:152 — sweep F9). WIRE-FINDING 20260920 redstack (first-hand, corrected from the F9/F14 docs claim): NO sol /v1/responses request carries any user-id header — the x-grok-* header set is agent/conv/session-scoped only (agent-id, conv-id, session-id, req-id, client-*) — so the identity surface is thinner than documented: no body identity AND no header user identity. RED today (no request body carries the user value or safety_identifier); GREEN when the cut plumbs config -> body identity. Control pin (class harness, plain assert): body.model eq gpt-5.6-sol on the main (oldest) request — the harness always sends the model. RE-PIN RULE: if the cut sends the user value in a different form (alias, normalization), re-pin the red to the landed shape.

ndjson.label: NO TERMINAL ERROR: the turn completed (the red is the body-identity seam, not the turn).
